ar: وَشَرِّفْ بِذَا قَدْرِيْ كَمَا أَنْتَ رَبُّنَا
tr: Wa sharrif bidhā qadrī kamā anta Rabbunā
en: Life-Taker, take me as a Muslim, affirming Unity – Honor thus my destiny as You are our Lord

tr: Wa Yā Ḥayyu Yā Qayyūmu qawwim umūranā
Wa Yā Wājidu anta ‘l-Ghaniyyu fa aghninā
en: O Living, O Self-Subsisting, rectify our affairs – O Concerned, You are Self-Sufficient, so enrich us

tr: Wa Yā Mājidu sharrif bi majdika qadranā
Wa Yā Wāḥidu farrij kurūbī wa ghammanā
en: O Exalted, with Your glory honor our ability – O Unique, dispel our worry and grief

tr: Wa Yā Ṣamadu fawwaḍtu amrī ilayka lā
Takilnī li nafsī wa ‘hdinā Rabbi sublanā
en: O Absolute, I entrust my affair to You – Do not leave me to my self and guide us, Lord, along our path
O Able, enable us to repel enemy attacks - O Omnipotent, sanctify our secrets from others
